state_layout.+0x00: acc[8] (u64); reset to the eight primes
state_layout.+0x40: inline secret copy (192 B); used when customSecret is NULL
state_layout.+0x204: useSeed flag (u32); 0 -> digest uses withSecret, != 0 -> digest uses withSeed
state_layout.+0x208: nbStripesSoFar (u64); stripe index in the current block
state_layout.+0x230: unknown (u64); never touched by these five functions
state_layout.+0x238: customSecret pointer; kSecret after reset; NULL -> state+0x40
state_layout.+0x240..0x280: unknown (64 B); never touched by these five functions

model.createState: malloc(0x280); on NULL return NULL; otherwise round the pointer up to the next 64-byte boundary (always advancing by 1..64 bytes), store the delta byte at -1(%rax), zero the seed field at +0x228, return the aligned pointer. Nothing else is initialised.
model.freeState: NULL -> return 0; otherwise free(ptr - byte[-1]) and return 0.
model.reset: NULL -> return 1 (XXH_ERROR); otherwise totalLen = 0, bufferedSize = 0, useSeed flag = 0, nbStripesSoFar = 0, acc = {0xC2B2AE3D, 0x9E3779B185EBCA87, 0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4F, 0x165667B19E3779F9, 0x85EBCA77C2B2AE63, 0x0000000085EBCA77, 0x27D4EB2F165667C5, 0x000000009E3779B1}, seed = 0, customSecret = kSecret (0x97ec80), nbStripesPerBlock = 16, secretLimit = 128; return 0 (XXH_OK).
model.update: NULL input -> return 0 with no state change (the length is not even read). Otherwise totalLen += len; if bufferedSize + len <= 256 the input is only appended to the buffer; if the buffer is non-empty it is filled to 256 bytes and consumed as 4 stripes; then full 64-byte stripes are consumed from the input in blocks of 16 (secret restarts at the block base, scrambleAcc after each block); the last 64 bytes of the consumed region are preserved at buffer[192..256) and the remaining tail is copied to buffer[0..), bufferedSize = tail length; acc is written back; return 0.
model.digest: totalLen <= 240 -> tail-call withSecret(buffer, totalLen, secret, 192) when the useSeed flag is 0, or withSeed(buffer, totalLen, seed) when it is not; secret is customSecret, or state+0x40 when customSecret is NULL. totalLen > 240 -> consume the remaining buffered stripes into a copy of acc (scrambling at the block boundary), accumulate the final 64-byte stripe with the secret window at secretLimit - 7, then mergeAccs (secret + 11) plus totalLen * PRIME64_1, then the XXH3 avalanche.
model.accumulate_512: Per 64-bit lane i: key = data[i] ^ secret[i]; acc[i] += (key & 0xFFFFFFFF) * (key >> 32) + data[i ^ 1]. Transliterated op by op from the AVX2 loop (pxor / pshufd $0x31 / pmuludq / pshufd $0x4e / paddq); a literal AVX2-op replay agrees with the scalar form on 200 random stripes.
model.scrambleAcc: acc[i] = (acc[i] ^ (acc[i] >> 47) ^ secret[i]) * 0x9E3779B1, secret window at secret + secretLimit (128). Confirmed in three places: update (0x61dc735), digest (0x61de6b3), one-shot withSecret (0x61dbb8b). The constant is the broadcast table at .rodata 0x4562c0, verified.
model.mergeAccs: Four pairs: (acc[2i] ^ secret[11+16i]) * (acc[2i+1] ^ secret[19+16i]) as a 128-bit product folded low ^ high, summed, plus totalLen * PRIME64_1, then the XXH3 avalanche (h ^= h>>37; h *= 0x165667919E3779F9; h ^= h>>32).
model.chunking_invariance: The digest is provably invariant to how the input is split across update calls: the binary's epilogue leaves a tail of up to 256 bytes, while the public rule consumes (len-1)//64 stripes and buffers a 1..64 byte tail; both splits accumulate the same stripes with the same secret offsets and the same final 64 bytes, and digest path B continues the stripe sequence from nbStripesSoFar. The model does not claim the binary uses the (len-1)//64 rule; it implements the binary's own buffer discipline and checks it against the one-shot reference over 2,400 chunkings.
model.short_path_reference: The digest's totalLen <= 240 path is checked against the one-shot reference in tools/xxh3_streaming115.py, which is itself pinned to the withSecret/withSeed disassembly (see the sibling packet re-002-node115-xxh3-with-secret-seed-115 for the 17..128 and 129..240 branches, including the len_129to240 helper at 0x61d7dc0).

return_value: createState: the aligned state pointer, or NULL on malloc failure. freeState: 0 always. reset: 0 (XXH_OK) or 1 (XXH_ERROR) on a NULL state. update: 0 always. digest: the 64-bit hash in %rax.
side_effects: createState allocates 0x280 bytes. reset and update write only the state fields listed in state_layout. digest writes nothing (it copies acc to the stack on the long path). None of the five functions reads outside [input, input+len), the state, and the secret windows listed in the model.
